decisionsTitle: A tick to stop messages that look like spam, off by default
decisionsSection:
**Amends §310.** **The owner, 2026-10-13, after two «[posibil spam]» messages reached the club:** «aș vrea o bifă ca să nu le mai primesc pe viitor, dar momentan ține-o debifată».

**Context.** Since §310 a contact message that passes every gate but looks automated is delivered marked, never refused, so that no person is lost. The mark is useful and the club files on it, but it still costs a read each time.

**Decision.** «Pagini» → «Contact» → «Cine primește mesajele de contact» gets one tick beside the three address boxes, in the same form and the same save: RO «Nu-mi trimite mesajele care par spam», EN "Don't send me messages that look like spam", with a «Bifat: … Debifat: …» line. It is **off by default**, and a row saved before it existed reads as off, so nothing changes on release. It is stored as a field of the existing `contactRecipients` JSON row in `platform_settings`: no migration, and the audit row of the save names it. Only an Administrator saves it; the service asserts the role as for the addresses.

*Ticked,* a message that the **existing** suspicion rule (`contactSuspicion`: no token while the challenge is on, a sender domain imitating the club's) marks is not emailed. It covers the contact form and the «Spune-ne ceva» forms that mark the same way (the three ordinary branches). The sender's answer is the same «mesaj trimis», to the byte, so a script learns nothing (§39, AGENTS.md §19.4). A message that is not suspicious is never affected. The safety branch is never held back: a lost report costs more than a marked one, and its bot answer is already its own (§676).

*Unticked,* the code path is exactly §310's: the same marked delivery, pinned by the existing tests and a new one.

**What is kept, and why only that.** The cost of holding back must stay visible, so the card says how many were stopped in the last 30 days. That is one timestamp and the form's name per held message, in one `platform_settings` row (`contactHeldBack`), pruned at every write and capped; never the text, the name, the address, the reasons or an IP. The repository is public and the privacy notice promises as little kept as possible: a timestamp and a form name are not personal data, so the privacy notice's template needs no word (it does not describe the marking today either).

**Refused.**
- Dropping a suspicious message without a trace: the owner could not tell the tick is working, nor notice a real person held back by mistake; the count is that signal.
- New heuristics: the same rule, because a second rule is a second thing to explain and to get wrong.
- Storing the held messages (even for a week): it would make the club hold exactly the data the tick exists to avoid, and a held message is only recoverable if someone reads it.
- Telling the sender: that is the oracle §310 already refused.
- Holding back the safety branch: see above.

**Who is stopped too.** §205 promised that a person with JavaScript off, or a blocked widget, still reaches the club: that person posts no token and is marked «fără token». Ticked, that real person is stopped as well, is told «trimis», and the 30-day count is the only trace; the tick's help line says so. It is the price of the tick, and the reason it stays off by default.

**Consequences.** `recordHeldBack` writes under an advisory lock in one transaction, so a flood of posts is counted one by one; a held feedback message logs a «held back as possible spam» line with the reasons' names only, as the contact form does; the card shows the count beside the tick (when the tick is on or the count is above 0) and the read-only view says whether the tick is on; `modules/contact/held-back.ts` (new: the pure `shouldHoldBack`, `holdBackIsOn`, `recordHeldBack`, `countHeldBack`); `contactRecipientsSchema` gains `holdBackSuspected` (default false); `contact/service.ts` and `feedback/service.ts` check it after the suspicion is read; `ContactRecipientsPanel` draws the tick and the count; `SETUP.md` §38 step 7 mentions it. Tests: `tests/unit/contact/hold-back.test.ts`, `tests/unit/contact/hold-back-panel.test.ts` (the card rendered), `tests/integration/contact/hold-back.test.ts`. No migration, no dependency.
changelogLine: - **A tick to stop messages that look like spam** — «Pagini» → «Contact» → «Nu-mi trimite mesajele care par spam», off by default; ticked, a message the form marks «[posibil spam]» is not emailed (contact and «Spune-ne ceva», not the safety branch) and the card only counts how many were stopped in 30 days; nothing of the message is kept. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Pagini» → «Contact» → «Cine primește mesajele de contact», when an Administrator ticks «Nu-mi trimite mesajele care par spam» (unticked by default, and unticked on a setting saved before it existed) and saves, then a message the existing suspicion check marks is not emailed — on the contact form and on the three ordinary «Spune-ne ceva» branches, never the safety branch — while the sender gets the same «sent» answer; a message that is not suspicious is delivered untouched; and only a timestamp and the form's name are kept, counted on the card for the last 30 days. Unticked, a suspicious message is delivered marked «[posibil spam]» exactly as before. Only an Administrator may save the tick. Tested in tests/unit/contact/hold-back.test.ts, tests/unit/contact/hold-back-panel.test.ts and tests/integration/contact/hold-back.test.ts (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
